items.title: McDonald’s (MCD) Stock Jumps As Q3 Earnings Beat Meets Growth Questions
items.summary: McDonald's stock jumped higher today, rising 6.6% to about US$280 after Q3 2026 earnings were released. Traders focused on straightforward headline numbers. Adjusted earnings per share came in at US$3.57 and restaurant-level profit reached nearly US$4.2b in the quarter. This short-term move sits against a slower grind in the longer-term story. Revenue over the trailing twelve months is US$27.8b, and current earnings forecasts indicate only mid single digit annual growth. The key question now...
